verdict.rationale: Sardine documents its own configurable risk logic: a no-code rule editor for transaction monitoring, rules built around business entities, and adjustable fuzzy-match thresholds. It also offers 'explainable scores', but the evidence ties these only to sanctions-match triage, not to a customer risk score. Nothing shows configurable customer risk factors (a CRA/risk-rating model) or a view explaining why a customer's score changed. Missing for 10: documented customer risk-rating factor configuration, risk-score change history or attribution view for compliance officers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
